mentions.name: Treesmith
mentions.description: An app for plotting and tracking trees over time, built in collaboration with orchardists and gardening groups. It lets growers record events such as grafting and fruiting so they can look back at each tree's history.
mentions.problem: It's hard to look back and see when trees were grafted or when they fruited over time without a tracking tool.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working with orchardist and gardening groups to build an app to plot and track your trees over time. It's useful to be able to look back and see when you graft trees, or when they fruited over time.
